Critical Infrastructure Protection

Comprehensive security solutions tailored to your specific operational requirements.

Industry Needs

With the rapid development of the low-altitude economy, low-altitude activities have become increasingly frequent. While the popularization of UAV technology brings convenience, it also triggers a series of low-altitude security issues such as unauthorized "black flights". Around critical infrastructure like power substations, hydroelectric dams, oil production bases, and chemical plants, unauthorized drone flights pose serious threats to operational safety. Preventing low-altitude risks and ensuring absolute facility security has become an urgent priority. Critical infrastructure protection uses optoelectronic turrets as core sensing units, equipped with dual-band detection technology to accurately capture UAV trajectories, identify targets, and synchronously transmit data 24/7. Relying on front-end sensing data, counter-UAV equipment combines radio monitoring and navigation deception, utilizing flexible fixed and mobile deployments. Through parameter optimization, it avoids interference with critical facility equipment. The coordinated system achieves fully automated operation, adapting to all-weather complex scenarios to efficiently defend against various low-altitude threats and ensure the safe and stable operation of critical infrastructure.

Solution Center

Airport Anti-UAV Application

Providing 24/7 protection for sensitive clearance areas such as airport surroundings and approach routes, blocking 'black-flight' UAVs from interfering with normal takeoff and landing. Linkage of wireless detection, suppression, and navigation deception ensures airport clearance safety and maintains civil aviation order.

VIEW DETAILS

Chemical Plant Protection

Chemical plants are high-risk areas filled with flammable and explosive facilities. The core of low-altitude security is achieving early warning and precise disposal of UAVs to prevent accidents or theft. Following explosion-proof principles, the system establishes electronic fences and deploys intelligent optoelectronic turntables for 24/7 monitoring using infrared thermal imaging. Once AI algorithms identify a drone, highest-level alerts are issued and trajectories tracked to ensure plant safety.

VIEW DETAILS

Hydroelectric Dam Protection

Focusing on key areas such as the dam body and power plants, the system addresses issues of complex terrain and numerous interferences. Optoelectronic turntables are deployed according to terrain, using thermal imaging to overcome water reflections and fog. Upon detecting suspicious drones, high-power interference is immediately activated for forced landing, without affecting power plant operations.

VIEW DETAILS

Oil Production Base Protection

Optoelectronic turntables are deployed atop high structures in the plant area, using ultra-long-range models to achieve seamless coverage of production areas, tank farms, and surrounding zones. Counter-UAV equipment uses layered strategies: peripheral detection, warning zone decoy-eviction, and core zone forced landing to fully mitigate security risks.

VIEW DETAILS

Power Generation Facility Anti-UAV

Customized for high-voltage thermal power plants, nuclear power plants, and core substation hubs. It automatically detects unauthorized mapping and reconnaissance flights, preventing foreign objects from falling and causing short circuits or damage to critical lines. The system is equipped with both fixed and portable countermeasures to ensure the stable operation of the energy industry.

VIEW DETAILS
